I-REPLAY:Valid successful origin; same producer/context; old ordered requests receive equal answers from new coherent image/catalogue; new admission receipt required

P-FINISH:Phase and custody relation includes success/failure, staging completeness and all borrowed resources
P-PUBLISH:I-ADMIT; per-consumer factorization; exact input receipt and metadata schema correspondence
P-OMITTED:Related selected phases, bound pending groups, resource accounting and frozen external observations; safety relation may require boundary recertification
P-SHARED-MACRO:Old input receipts invalid until all needed omitted groups revalidate; equal observations can recertify restricted safety, changed boundary observation rejects FrozenBoundary
